newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav border sealed against Albanians.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav border sealed against Albanians.

text.p: BELGRADE, March 14 (Reuter) Yugoslavia's border with Albania has been "hermetically sealed" against illegal immigration, Tanjug news agency quoted police and military sources as saying on Friday.
Yugoslav authorities fear the chaos in Albania could spill over into the southern Serbian province of Kosovo where the overwhelming majority of the 1.9 million population are ethnic Albanians

Yugoslav Army units in Kosovo have been placed on combat footing in case of trouble along the border which was closed on Thursday after clashes in neighbouring Macedonia between Macedonian and Albanian police.
No incidents were reported in Kosovo and Tanjug reported most frontier posts on the Albanian side of the border were no longer manned.
The border crossing between Montenegro and Albania at Bozaj was open on Friday but Tanjug said only a handful of people, all foreigners, crossed into Yugoslavia.
They included an Italian television crew robbed of their car and equipment by rebels shortly after they crossed into Albania.
The Macedonian government said U.N. peacekeeping troops in the former Yugoslav republic had opened three new observation posts on the Albanian border.
